services.name: Supabase — mh-systems-platform
services.note: Platform DB + backend (Edge Functions + pgvector). Each project = one schema. Never use public schema for app tables.

services.name: Ollama LLM (free default)
services.note: Default for chat, matching, summarization, meta-learning. Zero token cost.

services.name: Anthropic Claude (heavy tier)
services.note: ONLY on explicit admin request for heavy analysis/reports. Never routine.

services.name: GitHub Actions / Cron-Job.org
services.note: Secret-key-protected scheduled triggers to Edge Functions (D018).

services.name: Celery Worker
services.note: Superseded by Edge Functions + secret-key scheduler (D014/D018).

services.name: WhatsApp Gateway (FastAPI-coupled)
services.note: Legacy gateway/ calls FastAPI backend:8000. To remove (TD-006).

services.name: Google Drive
services.note: Excel sync out of scope; admin data load via CSV/backup upload.
